basic_details.job_title: One Stop Centre Jiribam Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Psycho-Social Counsellor, Para-Legal Personnel Posts
basic_details.short_information: Two contractual posts, one Psycho-Social Counsellor (women only) and one Para-Legal Personnel/Lawyer, are to be filled at the One Stop Centre, Jiribam under the Social Welfare Department, Manipur, by the Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Jiribam, Government of Manipur. Application forms are issued at Room No. 10 (ICDS), Deputy Commissioner Office Complex, Jiribam from 12 November 2026 to 26 November 2026, and filled forms must be submitted at the same room from 13 November 2026 to 22 November 2026, on all working days between 10 A.M. and 4 P.M. The engagement is for one year on contract.

content_sections.heading: About DC Jiribam Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Jiribam is the district administration office of Jiribam district in Manipur. This notice, dated 2 November 2026, engages staff for the One Stop Centre, Jiribam, which works under the Social Welfare Department, Manipur. The recruitment follows the Directorate of Social Welfare Department letter No. 6/94/2023 dated 6 June 2026.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application is made on a paper form. The notice does not mention applying by post or email; the form is collected from and submitted at the office below. Collect the application form from Room No. 10 (ICDS), Deputy Commissioner Office Complex, Jiribam, from 12 November 2026 to 26 November 2026, on all working days between 10 A.M. and 4 P.M. Fill in the application form. Attach duly attested copies of the documents listed under Enclosures below. Submit the filled form at Room No. 10 (ICDS), Deputy Commissioner Office Complex, Jiribam, from 13 November 2026 to 22 November 2026, on all working days between 10 A.M. and 4 P.M. The notice also directs the District Informatics Officer (NIC) to upload the notice and the application forms on the district website. The mode of paying the application fee is not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The remuneration is fixed as per FD (PIC) norms under RoP-2019. Open to women only: "Any Women having professional degree/diploma in psychology/psychiatry/neuroscience with the background in health sector". Preferably with at least 3 years' experience of working within a Govt. or Non Govt. health project/programme at the district level. Any person having a Degree in Law/with Legal Training or Knowledge of Laws, with at least 3 years experience of working within a Government or Non Government women related project/Programme at the District level. OR any practicing lawyer with at least 2 years experience of litigation in any court of Law. The age limit for both posts is 18 - 38 years as on the date of notification (the notice is dated 2 November 2026). The upper age limit is relaxable as follows: For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The filled application form must carry duly attested copies of: 10th Certificate/Age proof certificate Category certificate Certificate in support of educational qualifications Certificate in support of experience

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates for both posts will be selected on the basis of academic score, experience and personal interview. Each post is assessed out of a total of 50 marks, made up of five parts of up to 10 points each: the degree, Class 12th, Class 10th, experience and Viva-Voce. For the Psycho-Social Counsellor, the degree column is "BA/ Degree"; for the Para-Legal Personnel/Lawyer it is "Bachelors Degree in Law". The same point scale applies to the degree, 12th and 10th for both posts: Experience carries 10 to 0 points for both posts: The personal interview (Viva-Voce) carries 10 to 0 points. The notice states that details of the Interview/Viva Voce will be notified separately.

content_sections.text: The engagement is for a period of 1 (One) year on contractual basis. The engagement is purely on temporary basis and does not entail any claim for future regularization. Submission is accepted only on working days between 10 A.M. and 4 P.M.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DC Jiribam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Psycho-Social Counsellor and 1 Para-Legal Personnel/Lawyer at the One Stop Centre, Jiribam.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: Filled application forms must be submitted at Room No. 10 (ICDS), Deputy Commissioner Office Complex, Jiribam between 13 November 2026 and 22 November 2026, on working days from 10 A.M. to 4 P.M.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Psycho-Social Counsellor post?
faq.answer: The post is for women with a professional degree/diploma in psychology/psychiatry/neuroscience and a background in the health sector, preferably with at least 3 years' experience in a Govt. or Non Govt. health project/programme at the district level.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Para-Legal Personnel/Lawyer post?
faq.answer: A Degree in Law/with Legal Training or Knowledge of Laws with at least 3 years experience in a Government or Non Government women related project/Programme at the District level, or a practicing lawyer with at least 2 years experience of litigation in any court of Law.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 - 38 years as on the date of notification, with upper age relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC and 10 years for PWD candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the One Stop Centre posts?
faq.answer: Both posts carry ₹ 14,600/- p.m [Pre-revised GP: 2800], as per FD (PIC) norms under RoP-2019.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹ 500/- for Unreserved (UR) candidates and ₹ 200/- for OBC and SC/ST candidates; no fee is payable by PWD candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I get the application form?
faq.answer: The form can be collected from Room No. 10 (ICDS), Deputy Commissioner Office Complex, Jiribam from 12 November 2026 to 26 November 2026, on working days between 10 A.M. and 4 P.M.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is on academic score (degree, 12th and 10th), experience and Viva-Voce, each worth up to 10 points, for a total of 50 marks; interview details will be notified separately.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is for 1 year on contractual basis, purely temporary, and does not entail any claim for future regularization.
